project.name: XMage Nexus
project.tagline: Modern, polished web client for XMage (React 19 + TypeScript + WebSocket proxy).
project.stack: XMage Server 1.4.61-V1 · Mage.Proxy (Java 17) · React 19 + Vite + TS

release.notes: Primera build publica de XMage Nexus: cliente web moderno para XMage sobre un proxy WebSocket multi-usuario.
highlights: Lobby completo: mesas en vivo, chat de sala/partida, filtros, perfiles y clanes
Juego 1v1 y Commander (hasta 4 en tablero): prioridad, targeting visual, pago de mana, combate multibloqueo y stack
Deck Builder in-app (Scryfall) con import/export texto, Arena y .dck
Draft y Sealed de 8 jugadores, torneos Suizo/Eliminacion y visor de repeticiones
9 idiomas, motor de sonido, VFX y deck tracker integrado
Launcher de escritorio (Tauri) con servidor + proxy + JRE integrados

phases.name: XMage Proxy (bridge)
phases.desc: Java 17 proxy, WebSocket gateway, cycle-safe JSON serializer, multi-tenant sessions.

phases.name: Web Client: login + lobby + board
phases.desc: React 19 + Vite, lobby, chat, live tables/users, HD card cache, 1v1 board + spectator.

phases.name: Full Interaction
phases.desc: London mulligan, priority loops, visual targeting, mana payment, combat UI, X-costs, modals, counters.

phases.name: 1v1 Competitive Parity
phases.desc: Card selection modals (HD CardGrid), phase stops/shortcuts (F4/F9), match clocks, DFCs/Sagas, interactive discard from revealed hand (Thoughtseize).

phases.name: Visual Polish, Audio & Deck Builder
phases.desc: Web Audio engine (15 sfx, 3 buses), VFX (donut color pie, bars, shake), in-app deck builder (Scryfall full syntax t:creature c:red cmc<=3 o:haste, help, 9-lang, curve+donut, vertical CMC sort, plain/dck/arena export+clipboard, file drag-drop, goldfish T1-3) — customization playmats/sleeves tracked as Phase 3.1 stretch.

phases.name: Desktop Packaging (Tauri)
phases.desc: Tauri wrapper, embedded one-click proxy + JRE, auto-updater.

phases.name: Advanced Formats & Tournaments
phases.desc: Commander pod (PodBoard 2x2 render clamp 4 — server supports FFA 3-10 — + TurnOrderRing + CommanderDamageMatrix), Booster Draft & Sealed (8-player, DraftScreen + ConstructScreen), Swiss/SE brackets (TournamentBracket/Panel) + Replay viewer.

phases.name: Wizard Crear Mesa — cierre de gaps vs desktop NewTableDialog
phases.desc: NumPlayers (min/max del oráculo, Commander/FFA 3-10), asientos por plaza SeatConfig[] (tipo+deck), validación deck↔game (port checkMatchOptions), limited fix F8 + limited:true, wins 1-5, mulligans 0-5, persistencia mage_createTable_v1, proxy contrato extendido (mulliganType/customLife/Hand/planeChase/bannedUsers), Custom Options UI (badge Custom(n)), draft exhaustive 21 tournamentTypes + 46 draftCubes (draftCubeName), simDecks por plaza. Delta 2026-09-06: skill por plaza 1-10 (seatSkills web→SimManager→SimPlayer) + skill propia, UI de vetados y de rondas (0=auto), range/attack por flags del servidor, validación por paso, hint vivo por plaza. F11: plazas HUMAN en espera (solo-humanos, tipos normalizados a enum canónico). F6 emblemas fuera de alcance. Docs lobby_roadmap §F, oráculo server-state-schema.json.

features.feature: Commander / EDH (server FFA 3-10; board render clamp 4)

guards.name: callbackCoverage
guards.desc: Every server callback has a client handler or is listed as planned.

guards.name: mechanicsCoverage
guards.desc: Every mage.view.* field the server can emit is modeled in contract.schema.json / types.generated.ts (reverse-drift).

guards.name: engineViewCoverage
guards.desc: Engine state in mage.game.* not copied into mage.view.* DTOs is tracked against a baseline.
guards.note: Known gaps: harnessed / monstrous / renowned / player-targeting. goad shown via cardIcons/rules (not a gap). Guard: web/src/state/engineViewCoverage.test.ts + scripts/engine-view-schema.mjs

guards.name: serverStateCoverage
guards.desc: CreateTable formats (gameTypes/deckTypes) are exhaustive vs Mage.Server/config/config.xml — no drift when offline/fake.
